start.title: 荒野を越えて
start.text:
あなたは慣れ親しんだ丘を越えて群れを導く。
奇妙な光が前方にちらつく。

ignore_consequence.title: それはあなたを離れないだろう
ignore_consequence.text:
光はさらに明るくちらつく。
あなたは見なかったふりをすることはできない。

stone_consequence.title: そのようなことではない
stone_consequence.text:
嘲りは子供には似合うが、男には似合わない。
謙遜して見に行きなさい。

approach_mountain.title: 山に向かって
approach_mountain.text:
ホレブ山が静かにあなたの前にそびえ立つ。
その斜面に輝きがある。

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] This sight is meant for you.

run_back_consequence.title: あなたはそれから逃れることはできない
run_back_consequence.text:
その輝きはあなたの記憶に焼き付いている。
戻って真実を見なさい。

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You turn back to the slope.

call_jethro_consequence.title: これはあなたのためだ
call_jethro_consequence.text:
ここに立つべきは他に誰もいない。
行きなさい、そして見なさい。

see_bush.title: [TODO:ja] It Burns and Is Not Consumed
see_bush.text:
[TODO:ja] Flame wraps the bush. Yet it stands whole.
Nothing turns to ash.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You will see this great sight.
[TODO:ja] This fire is not yours to stop.
[TODO:ja] Do not turn from holy ground.

smother_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Do Not Touch
smother_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] This fire is not of your world.
Approach with awe, not hands.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] What hides from you is also revealed.
Step into the light.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You step out from the rock.

voice_calls.title: [TODO:ja] "Moses! Moses!"
voice_calls.text:
[TODO:ja] A voice from the flame calls your name.
It knows you fully.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Bow First
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] You stand before holiness, not a man.
Answer with humility.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Answer Him
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] He called your name aloud.
Do not leave Him with silence.

remove_sandals.title: [TODO:ja] Holy Ground
remove_sandals.text:
[TODO:ja] "Take off your sandals, Moses.
The place where you stand is holy."

refuse_sandals_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Obey First
refuse_sandals_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Comfort matters less than holiness.
Do as He asks.

argue_sandals_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] He Decides
argue_sandals_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] He is the one who calls it holy.
Kneel and obey.

hide_face.title: [TODO:ja] I Am the God of Your Fathers
hide_face.text:
[TODO:ja] "I am the God of Abraham, Isaac,
and Jacob." You hide your face.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] No man may see and live.

look_up_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Lower Your Eyes
look_up_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] His glory is more than you can bear.
Listen, do not stare.

see_affliction.title: [TODO:ja] I Have Seen Their Misery
see_affliction.text:
[TODO:ja] "I have heard My people cry in Egypt.
I will deliver them by your hand."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] Do not flee what He calls.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Not by Your Might
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] It is not your strength that frees them.
Speak honestly.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Do Not Flee
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] You ran from Egypt once before.
This time, listen first.

i_will_be_with_you.title: [TODO:ja] I Will Be With You
i_will_be_with_you.text:
[TODO:ja] "I will be with you," He says.
"This shall be the sign."

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Ask His name to tell them

bargain_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] His Word Is Enough
bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] He has spoken. Trust the voice.
Ask only what is needed.

choices.text: [TODO:ja] Ask His name to tell them

i_am.title: [TODO:ja] I AM WHO I AM
i_am.text:
[TODO:ja] "Tell them I AM has sent you."
The name fills the silence.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] You hold it in your heart.

question_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] Some Names Are Received
question_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] You will not grasp it with the mind.
Receive it with the heart.

accept_mission.title: [TODO:ja] Go, Moses
accept_mission.text:
[TODO:ja] "Go. Speak to Pharaoh.
Lead My people out of Egypt."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] He will give you the words.

plead_consequence.title: [TODO:ja] He Will Give the Words
plead_consequence.text:
[TODO:ja] Your tongue is not your strength.
His word will be on your lips.

another_consequence.title: 主はあなたを選ばれた
another_consequence.text:
主が茂みの中からあなたの名を呼ばれた。
あなたはそれを避けて通ることはできない。

stand_resolved.title: あなたは立ち上がる
stand_resolved.text:
炎は燃え続けている。茂みはまだそこにある。
あなたの心はもはや以前のままではない。

choices.feedback: [TODO:ja] The road home is the road forward.
[TODO:ja] You are no longer a shepherd of sheep.

return_sheep_consequence.title: 羊ではない — 民
return_sheep_consequence.text:
あなたの群れは今やイスラエルの子らである。
エジプトに向かって進め。

ending.title: エジプトへ
ending.text:
荒野があなたの前に広がる。
神は目に見えない形であなたの傍らを歩まれる。
